title: update_delivery_state/update_read_at: state counter advances before UPDATE (non-atomic)
description: message.rs::update_delivery_state and update_read_at both call advance_state_counter() before the UPDATE statement. If the UPDATE finds 0 rows (message not found) and returns an error, the counter was already incremented, leaving a permanent hole in state_version sequence. Same pattern fixed in insert and mark_failed. Fix: wrap counter advance + UPDATE in unchecked_transaction, same as insert.
